messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert — runtime queueing spike on /v1/generate (us-west-2). error_rate +8% in 5m. paging @morgan_oncall

morgan_oncall: I'm on it, jumping into metrics now.

morgan_oncall: inflight at ~98% of pool capacity, tail latency >2.5s, backlog increasing.

sam_sre: switching traffic shaper to soft-shed for the affected slice, will cap throughput at 70% to reduce queuing.

morgan_oncall: go ahead. also enable a per-route rate limit on /v1/embed to protect the runtime.

li_runtime: recommend reducing max_in_flight 120 -> 60 and lowering request timeout 30000ms -> 18000ms on that slice. helps shed long-running requests.

jess_prod: tagging product + CS — possible customer-visible 5xxs for heavy batch embedding workloads.

anya_cs: I'll notify impacted customers and prep a status update. pinging top candidates now.

sam_sre: applied shaper: /ops/traffic-shaper update slice=us-west-2 throughput=0.7 (cmd output)
```
$ redwoodctl shaper update --slice us-west-2 --throughput 0.7
success: updated slice us-west-2
```

morgan_oncall: applying per-route cap for embeddings in us-west-2:
```
$ redwoodctl routes update --route /v1/embed --region us-west-2 --max_rps 5
```

li_runtime: deploying runtime config changes now (max_in_flight + timeout). rolling restart of pool with 1-at-a-time restart policy:
```
runtime.conf max_in_flight=60
runtime.conf request_timeout_ms=18000
deploy: rolling restart runtime-pool-us-west-2
```

sam_sre: rolling restart kicked off. ETA ~45s per node. We'll watch the drain.

morgan_oncall: also toggled prefix caching to aggressive to cut KV load temporarily.

incident-bot: Note — autoscaler for us-west-2 dedicated pool paused to avoid noisy spin-ups while we stabilize.

jess_prod: quick customer-impact summary for status page: low-rate API users largely unaffected; heavy batch embedding tenants may see failures or increased latency. CS will send targeted notes.

anya_cs: messages sent to Acme and BetaCo; Acme asked for ETA, I replied 30-60m for stabilization.

sam_sre: first node finished restart, CPU down to 78%, inflight for that node at 60, backlog is trending down.

morgan_oncall: good progress. keep shaper and route cap in place for 20m, then cautiously raise to 85% if backlog < threshold.

li_runtime: saw a memory growth pattern in the KV cache during this spike — filing a follow-up ticket INF-452 to investigate eviction behavior.

morgan_oncall: thanks everyone. I'll stay on watch until metrics are stable for two consecutive 5m windows. Tentative close if steady in 30m. :thumbsup:
